JarvisBrain.description: The central AI orchestration and management system for Jarvis.

WindowsDesktopClient.description: The Jarvis application running on Windows desktop, providing full AI conversation and computer-use capabilities.

AndroidApplication.description: The Jarvis application running on Android devices, enabling AI voice/text conversations and remote Windows control.

features: Receiving results and reports from Windows
Using Android telephony and messaging capabilities

ComputerUseEngine.description: Responsible for automating Windows desktop interactions, including visual perception and physical control.

capabilities: Screen understanding using computer vision and OCR
Identifying UI elements (buttons, menus, text fields, icons, links)
Observing and verifying the results of actions
security_considerations: All actions must pass through central permission service
No direct access to sensitive operations
Clear user observation of computer-use activity

PermissionService.description: Centralized service for enforcing permission policies across all Jarvis components and operations.

RoamiesAIOrchestrator.description: An AI agent sidecar providing advanced AI orchestration, voice integration, persistent memory, and various integrations.

PythonTelephonyAdapter.description: Existing Python component for cellular communication and call management via Android ADB.

USSDManager.description: Existing Python component for managing USSD-based balance checks on Android devices.

FastAPIService.description: The main orchestrator and API layer exposing core Jarvis services.

VoiceSpeechEngine.description: Handles speech-to-text and text-to-speech for voice interactions.

PersistentMemory.description: Stores conversation history, user preferences, and context across sessions.

HolographicInterface.description: A premium, futuristic holographic interface featuring a custom 3D hologram character.

JarvisBrainServesWindowsClient.description: The Jarvis Brain provides core AI and backend services to the Windows Desktop Client.

JarvisBrainServesAndroidApp.description: The Jarvis Brain provides core AI and backend services to the Android Application.

WindowsClientUsesComputerEngine.description: The Windows Desktop Client utilizes the Computer Use Engine for desktop automation.

JarvisBrainEnforcesPermissions.description: The Jarvis Brain relies on the Permission Service for enforcing access policies.

PermissionServiceGovernsComputerEngine.description: The Permission Service governs the actions performed by the Computer Use Engine.

PermissionServiceGovernsAndroidApp.description: The Permission Service governs the capabilities and actions of the Android Application.

JarvisBrainIntegratesRoamies.description: The Jarvis Brain integrates the Roamies AI Orchestrator for advanced AI and automation capabilities.

FastAPIServiceExposesTelephony.description: The FastAPI Service exposes the Python Telephony Adapter functionality via its API.

FastAPIServiceExposesUSSD.description: The FastAPI Service exposes the USSD Manager functionality via its API.

RoamiesUsesFastAPI.description: The Roamies AI Orchestrator interacts with the FastAPI Service to access telephony and USSD features.

WindowsClientUsesVoiceEngine.description: The Windows Desktop Client utilizes the Voice and Speech Engine for voice interaction.

AndroidAppUsesVoiceEngine.description: The Android Application utilizes the Voice and Speech Engine for voice interaction.

JarvisBrainUsesPersistentMemory.description: The Jarvis Brain uses Persistent Memory to store and retrieve conversation history and user preferences.

WindowsClientHasHolographicInterface.description: The Windows Desktop Client presents a Holographic Interface as its primary visual interaction.

HolographicInterfaceUsesVoiceEngine.description: The Holographic Interface integrates the Voice and Speech Engine for voice commands and responses.

OneJarvisBrainMultipleClients.pattern_name: One Jarvis Brain → Multiple Clients → Shared Services
OneJarvisBrainMultipleClients.description: A centralized AI brain serving multiple client applications (Windows, Android) and shared backend services.
benefits: Shared AI brain, memory, user identity, permissions, task history, and integrations
constraints: Requires robust communication between clients and backend
Centralized points of failure if not properly designed for high availability

HybridIntegrationRoamies.description: Integrates Roamies' advanced desktop control and AI orchestration while preserving and extending existing Python telephony and USSD services.
benefits: Leverages Roamies' capabilities without rebuilding existing proven components
constraints: Potential for integration complexity and interface challenges
Requires careful management of AGPL-3.0 compliance for Roamies components

PerceptionActionVerificationLoop.description: A cyclical process for the Computer Use Engine to observe, understand, plan, execute, and verify actions on the Windows desktop.
benefits: Ensures reliable and verifiable execution of tasks
Allows for safe recovery from unexpected states
constraints: Requires efficient computer vision and OCR

FivePermissionOperatingModes.description: A hierarchical permission system with five distinct modes to balance AI autonomy with human authority over sensitive operations.
benefits: Reduces permission fatigue for routine tasks
Ensures human oversight for critical decisions
constraints: Requires careful definition of decision boundaries and escalation conditions
Complex to implement and integrate across all components

ModularLayers.description: Organizing Jarvis into distinct, interconnected modules for better maintainability, scalability, and independent development.
benefits: Easier to update or replace individual components
constraints: Requires well-defined interfaces and communication protocols between layers
Potential for overhead if modules are too fine-grained

MemorySync.data_type: Conversation History, User Preferences, Task State

FiveOperatingModes.description: A hierarchical permission model with five modes: Autonomous, Delegated Authority, Conditional Autonomy, Approval Required, and Human-Only Authority.

PersistentDelegationPolicies.description: Structured JSON policies defining objectives, authorized actions, constraints, decision boundaries, and escalation conditions for delegated tasks.
PersistentDelegationPolicies.enforcement_strength: High, policies persist and are auditable

CentralSecurityEnforcement.description: Centralized security enforcement covering secure account authentication, device registration, encrypted communication, and audit logging.
CentralSecurityEnforcement.enforcement_strength: Strict, with token authentication and rate limiting

ConstraintBasedExecution.description: Tasks are executed based on defined objectives, authorized actions, constraints, and decision boundaries, preventing unauthorized actions.
ConstraintBasedExecution.enforcement_strength: Moderate, with intelligent escalation to human for boundaries

IntelligentEscalation.description: Protocol for pausing tasks, clearly explaining issues, presenting alternatives, and resuming tasks after human input for ambiguous or boundary-crossing situations.
IntelligentEscalation.enforcement_strength: Adaptive, ensures human control at critical junctures

AGPL30Compliance.description: Ensuring adherence to AGPL-3.0 for Roamies integration, requiring source code availability for modified versions and network service use.

CallConfirmation.description: All outgoing cellular calls require explicit user confirmation before execution to prevent unauthorized usage.
